full_details: At St Helen's Master Thwaite read the Lord Mayor's precept against blue starch, with the Mayor ten yards off in a white ruff. He preached on it. The glass was turned once, and again. He reached fourteenthly. A draper's wife in the north aisle was blue at the band and looked at the roof. Alse's band was white. Mistress Ansell called it sound doctrine. You said fourteen parts, and she said it was the first sermon you had heard to the end. At the door Alse asked who decides where a permitted shade ends. Nobody told her. At home you put the laugh into one breath and called it a war with a colour. You did not add a line to the garden. The parliament sheet from Saturday is still blank. Susanna's letter is still on the chest.
one_sentence: You heard the blue-starch precept out to the fourteenth head, and laughed once at home.
title: Fourteen heads of the blue-starch precept
